description: Exact contents of the Supermarket Pro customer release (R4 §4). Paths are relative to new_app/backend. Enforced by tests/unit/test_customer_package_boundary.py; the running application never reads this file.

notes.enforcement: backend/tools/license_generator/ is owner-only and never part of the customer distribution (pyproject packages only app*).
notes.keys: Only PUBLIC Ed25519 material ships: verification_keys.json (base64 of 32 raw bytes) and release_metadata.json (sha256 fingerprints).
notes.install_key: app/services/backup_manifest.py builds an Ed25519 key from the per-install backup signing key held in <DATA_DIR>; that key is generated at runtime and never appears in the package, which is why it is not a forbidden-content marker.
notes.state: <LICENSE_STATE_DIR> and <DATA_DIR> are customer state created at runtime, never package contents.
notes.tests: Developer tests and helper scripts are excluded from both roots.
